annotation.title_clean: Digitalisation, artificial intelligence and algorithmic management in the workplace – shaping the future of work
annotation.title_en: Digitalisation, artificial intelligence and algorithmic management in the workplace – shaping the future of work
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series, C/2026/2154)
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament legislative-initiative resolution (Art. 225 TFEU) asking the Commission to propose a directive on algorithmic management in the workplace. It addresses worker information, consultation, human oversight, data protection, health and safety, and skills, while seeking to avoid burdens on SMEs. It has no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Asks the Commission to propose, after an impact assessment, an algorithmic management law based on Arts. 153 and 16 TFEU
Employers must give workers written information on algorithmic management systems and consult worker representatives under Directive 2002/14/EC
Proposes banning processing of workers' emotional, neurological and biometric data, off-duty data and private communications
Requires continuous human oversight; hiring, dismissal, pay and disciplinary decisions must be taken by a human
Requires health and safety risk assessment for AI deployment, enforced by labour inspectorates, with SME proportionality and non-regression
